question: Which programme, that was introduced in the year 2000-2001, aims to offer homes, drinking water, primary education and basic healthcare in rural areas?

options.text: The Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Gramodaya Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Gramodaya Yojana (PMGY)** was launched in the **financial year 2000-2001**.
 
• The programme primarily aims to promote **rural development** by focusing on providing essential services like **housing, drinking water, primary education, and basic healthcare** to rural areas.
